# Diff lock switch installation using SPST

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Wire Pins 2, 3, 6, and 7 with specific colors to install an SPST diff lock switch. [t751]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Identify the five wires going to the switch: two for illumination, two for locker function, and one power from ignition.
2. [Partial] Wire Pin 2 with a Yellow wire.
3. [Partial] Wire Pin 3 with a White/Green wire.
4. [Partial] Wire Pin 6 with a Red wire.
5. Wire Pin 7 with a Brown wire.
6. Leave Pin 8 blank if utilizing the dash diff lock light to avoid having both lights on simultaneously.

_Procedure reported by [t751]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-swap-stock-switches-to-otrattw-switches.5311/>_

## Parts

- [Partial] SPST On/Off Switch [t751]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Note that the stock switch is a DPDT On/On, but an SPST works well if you have performed diff lock mods. [t751]
